discovery

Bakobo .well-known discovery

Machine clients should start at host-meta.json (RFC 6415 link relations and lookup templates), or fetch the full discovery catalog. To resolve a known identifier directly, GET /.well-known/oobi/<SAID>/index.json.

What these witnesses do and do not establish

Bakobo operates every witness listed here and also controls the AIDs they witness, so a receipt from this pool establishes that an event was witnessed and is being served -- it is evidence of availability, not of controller-accountability. A validator who needs protection against a controller colluding with its own witnesses must get it from a process under that validator's control, not from these receipts.

This is a property of who runs the pool, not of the software. The remedy is a different operator rather than a different configuration, and it is a rotation rather than a rebuild: growing the pool so that not every witness is ours is one event per identifier, and it is the same event that swaps an operator in.

What is not here

Bakobo has incepted no organisational identifiers yet. The pool exists and is serving; there is simply nothing using it, so this catalog lists witnesses and nothing else. ACDC credential schemas are published separately, with their own manifest, at https://schema.bakobo.com/.
